questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I am doing a project at ETH so I didn't take any courses, but as far as I experience there, I feel the KU working culture is more chill, at ETH I'm at a lab which is always very stressful and they expected me work there 8 hours per day like normal working time. But as a student doing research at KU before mostly I can manage my own time, KU professor and supervisor are so nice to me. But at ETH lab some people at the lab are kinda micromanaged me so still very stressful and competitive and I have to work on weekends. But I believe it varies from lab to lab at ETH, not all labs are like that. overall ETH is a super good university for doing research and Switzerland is the amazing country you can always explore natures like paradise.

questions.answer: The room is easy to get from the ETH exchange housing office. The thing is my project will end on 17th of February but the contract of the room is until the 31 of January. And they are not allowing me to extend the contract which is very inconvenient so I have to find an Airbnb to live.
